REFERENCE-PRESERVING KINETIC PULSES AND FINITE ENTROPY INFERENCE
2026-10-31. Derived theorem and finite acquisition contract.

1. Target, interface and organizing construction

Let Q be an unknown finite irreducible all-even continuous-time Markov
generator, with stationary law pi and reciprocal edge support. Write
a_ij=pi_i q_ij. The target is the ZERO-FIELD STATIONARY MEAN entropy
production rate
 sigma_0=sum_{i<j} (a_ij-a_ji) log(a_ij/a_ji).
It is not realised entropy on the pulse, mean jump activity, maximum
escape rate, controlled-law identification or the entire device heat.
Stationary preparation and deterministic state labels are supplied.
The formula is the conventional Markov path-irreversibility rate. Its
physical entropy interpretation requires the appropriate all-even
time reversal and local detailed balance; unresolved physical channels
can add dissipation rather than being identified by this measurement.

A prescribed kinetic pulse has q^m_ij(t)=m_ij(t)q_ij off diagonal,
m_ij(t)=m_ji(t)>=0, and repaired diagonals. Its known dimensionless
amplitude envelope is m_ij(t)<=M(t). Define B=integral_0^T M(t)dt>0.
Q, pi, state count, mixing time and an escape-rate cap are not inputs.
The physical time T and amplitude envelope are inputs. Uniform
observed-label cut gating is one possible implementation, not an
operation whose microscopic qualification follows from two bits.

Construct a VIRTUAL reversible generator R by
 pi_i R_ij=sqrt(a_ij a_ji), i!=j,
and repair its diagonal. It is reversible with stationary law pi. Every
symmetric pulse R^m remains stationary at pi, even for a time-varying
prescribed symmetric protocol. This is the organizing fact: the
comparison law retains its initial measure during the full pulse.
R need never be fitted, implemented or observed. The geometric-mean
reversiblization and its fixed-pi information projection are established
tools, credited in Section 7. The finite-pulse use is the result derived
here; inventing this generator is not a contribution claimed here.

2. Exact path relative entropy, including waiting terms

For two finite CTMCs started with the same pi, the log path-density ratio
is the sum of log jump-rate ratios minus the integral of escape-rate
differences. Under the reference R^m, the expected number of i->j jumps
per dt is pi_i m_ij R_ij dt. Thus
 D(P_(R^m)^pi || P_(Q^m)^pi)
 = integral sum_{i!=j} pi_i

FINITE KINETIC-PULSE OPENING: RESULT AND SELECTION CONCLUSION
2026-10-31

Main result

For an unknown finite stationary all-even reciprocal CTMC, a prescribed
symmetric rate pulse with known amplitude-time exposure B gives
 sigma_0 >= 4 kl(p_initial || p_terminal)/B.
This is finite amplitude and finite time. A geometric-mean reversible
reference keeps its stationary measure under the pulse; reverse path
KL, including waiting terms, is at most B sigma_0/4. The reference
generator and its information projection are established mathematics,
not claimed inventions. PROOF.txt gives the derivation, assumptions,
N713 source distinction, ordinary comparators and primary references.

What burden was removed

The finite experiment does not need a hidden state-count/rank promise,
a hidden upper escape rate, exact full controlled word probabilities,
generator reconstruction or a response derivative at zero time/field.
Its resources are many independent stationary starts, a qualified
microscopic symmetric gate with known dimensionless envelope, a
calibrated physical pulse duration and a deterministic calibrated bit.
These resources remain supplied. The earlier one-preparation finite
mean-entropy obstruction is preserved; it is not bypassed by relabelling
one hidden trajectory as independent preparations.

Actual frozen controls

Each source: 32768 independent starts, T=1/40, gate=16, risk=1/80.
Driven three-state ring: source entropy 9 log(10)=20.72326584.
  Frozen receiver lower floor: 0.9683645769 nats/model-time.
  Stronger ordinary coupled KL floor: 0.9766988742.
Matched equilibrium ring: true entropy 0; both floors return 0.
The ordinary method beats the frozen receiver on the SAME records,
confidence set and risk. No algorithmic advantage is established.

Before draws, exact uniformization and a fixed rational witness certified
a source power-event floor 0.5097011871, above the frozen 1/2 target,
with miss probability at most 1/80. Both seeded records were drawn once
and persisted before inference; no redraws. Replay preserves all scientific
payload fields. This is internal exact mathematical validation, not an
independent audit. No physical experiment was performed.

Cost across both sources: 65536 independent preparations, 131072 bit
readouts, 1638.4 model-time units of pulse exposure, 287821 simulated
